summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that shareholders approved all matters at its AGM, including election of directors and re-appointment of auditor. The filing also updates its proposed acquisition of Toro Energy Ltd. via scheme of arrangement under Australian Corporations Act. Toro shareholders approved the scheme on June 9, 2026, with 92.89% in favour. The scheme is subject to Federal Court of Australia approval on June 15, 2026, expected effective June 16, 2026, and implemented June 25, 2026. No price/share, premium, or advisor named. Watch for court approval and closing conditions.
